articles.executive_summary: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software. A memory-corruption flaw in Google's Brotli decoder sits in many programs that unpack Brotli-compressed data, among them Bun, the Python Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy proxies set up to decompress Brotli.
